examples.name: LLM Server - Basic
examples.description: Simple local model server with minimal configuration. Demonstrates basic LLMServer setup with OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

examples.name: LLM Server - With Bridge
examples.description: Using LLMClientBridge with multiple backends and proxy features. Includes round-robin routing, rate limiting, health checking, and retry policies.

examples.name: LLM Server - Cost Optimization
examples.description: Cost-based routing between local and cloud backends. Automatically routes requests to the most cost-effective backend based on token costs.

examples.name: LLM Server - High Availability
examples.description: Multiple backends with failover and health checking. Automatically fails over to backup backends if the primary fails, with configurable retry policies.
